title: 低位静态长伸
description: 丙烯画表现双脚有支撑的较长静态伸展，身体没有离墙腾空。

art_direction.medium: two-ink risograph with teal and coral spot colors and precise drawn anatomy
art_direction.scene: Create an original acrylic painting of a fictional clothed adult making a longer but fully static reach across a low vertical bouldering panel. One hand stays on a generous sidepull, both shoes press distinct positive footholds, and the reaching hand extends toward a broad neighboring hold without leaving the supporting stance. Keep the hips low and the feet only a short step above thick continuous crash mats. Compose a wide horizontal scene with the route extending laterally, not high above the figure. Use broad cobalt and coral brush marks, warm overhead light, and believable adult anatomy. Avoid airborne motion, forced flexibility, writing, logos, or anyone beneath the route.
